purpose: Single pinned release used by the docs PR check. Bump this together with docs/docs/getting-started/installation.md, docs/docs/index.md and docs/docs/changelog.md when a release is published.
whyPinned: A PR check that reads the live Maven Central release would turn older commits red the moment a new release is published. The live comparison runs on a schedule instead. Bumped 0.61.2-public -> 0.62.0-public together with the docs sync, after release/0.58.x picked up 19f21df6 (prepare 0.62.0-public).
